scripts.validate: npm run test:docs && npm run check && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:editorial && npm run test:monitoring
scripts.staging:check: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.git/runtime-config XDG_CACHE_HOME=.git/runtime-cache WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
